description: Deterministic transform formula and fixed-record layout shared byte-for-byte between the Java and Rust suites. Every transform variant (pure Java, scalar downcall, batched downcall, zero-copy downcall, pure Rust baseline) must apply the identical formula; every validation variant must agree on the identical fixed-record layout and expected-value derivation.

numericTransform.note: Identical in pl.kzybala.lab.ffminterop.FfmInteropOps#transformScalarPureJava (Java) and transform_scalar_pure (Rust) — the FFI wrappers on both sides call into this same logic, never a parallel reimplementation.

fixedRecordValidation.layout: bytes[0..8) = id (LE u64), bytes[8..16) = value (LE u64)
fixedRecordValidation.note: A record is valid iff its stored value equals expectedValue(id). ffm_validate_records/validateRecords return the count of invalid records, or -1 if the buffer length is not a multiple of 16 bytes (an input-shaped error, never a panic/exception).

callbackNotification.note: The upcall variant invokes its callback exactly once per input element, in input order, with that element's transformed value — verified identically by both languages' test suites.
